title: Polymarket exec says KYC limited to beta product, not existing platform
summary: Polymarket executive Josh Stevens said identity checks apply only to early beta access and are not being added to Polymarket’s existing platform.

title: BIS Project Agorá shows tokenized payments can settle in seconds
summary: The Bank for International Settlements' collaboration with seven central banks and more than 40 institutions concludes a two-year project with a prototype settling wholesale payments in seconds.

title: Crypto liquidations hit $935M as Bitcoin price dips to $72.6K
summary: Over $935 million was wiped out across the crypto market as traders shifted their focus to $70,000 as the last line of defense for Bitcoin.

title: Crypto companies have tightened compliance, but gaps remain: Chainalysis
summary: Around 47% of crypto organizations onboarded in 2026 are operating at alerting standards that would have ranked among the industry’s strictest five years ago.

title: Crypto markets shed $80B after fresh US strikes on Iran
summary: The crypto market capitalization has fallen to its lowest level since mid-April after the US carried out strikes on Iran for the second time in three days amid peace talks.

title: CFTC seeks to reverse settlement deal with Gemini
summary: The CFTC claimed that its settled complaint filed under the Biden administration relied heavily on a whistleblower’s allegations that Gemini inflated trading activity to distort user demand.

title: Bitcoin funding spike shows longs defending $70K: Will ETF outflows reverse bulls’ efforts?
summary: Bitcoin dropped closer to a critical support level as spot and long futures traders’ efforts to hold $75,000 failed. Is sub-$70,000 BTC next?

title: US charges Google employee with insider trading bets on Polymarket
summary: The Justice Department and the CFTC allege that Google software engineer Michele Spagnuolo profited $1.2 million on Polymarket after accessing non-public information at work.

title: Kraken rolls out Bitcoin vault product for holders to earn yield
summary: Within the first 10 hours of launch, the Kraken Earn BTC Vault raked in $30 million worth of Bitcoin deposits from 4,000 unique wallets.

title: Bitcoin falls further as BTC miners pivot to AI, pro-crypto legislation stalls
summary: Bitcoin’s underperformance of stocks deepened as BTC miners pivoted to AI and pro-crypto regulation in the United States stalled.
